source.title: The effects of rehearsal on the functional neuroanatomy of episodic autobiographical and semantic remembering: a functional magnetic resonance imaging study.

confidence_rationale: Demonstrates a robust and durable functional dissociation between episodic-autobiographical and semantic remembering (distinct regional patterns surviving 8 rehearsals; hippocampus specific to autobiographical). This cuts both ways for Q-060: the dissociation is real (could be read as supporting a distinct type), but it is localised WITHIN the episodic/MTL machinery -- the hippocampal vividness/recollection signal -- consistent with autobiographical being richly-tagged episodic content rather than a parallel semantic-like store.
failure_signatures: Both autobiographical and semantic retrieval co-engaged parahippocampal cortex; only the hippocampus was autobiographical-specific. A clean first-class autobiographical TYPE separate from episodic would predict a dedicated store, not a graded hippocampal-vividness modulation of the shared episodic system.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Episodic-autobiographical and semantic memory produce distinctly different regional activation patterns that persist even after eight repetitions; the hippocampus is specifically engaged by vivid episodic-autobiographical recollection whereas parahippocampal cortex serves both, supporting multiple-trace theory.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports REE's ARC-085 'one substrate, not two parallel machineries' thesis: autobiographical recollection is the high-vividness, hippocampus-engaging mode of the episodic store (ARC-007), distinguished by retained contextual/self tags rather than residing in a separate semantic-type store. Consistent with MECH-121 (episodic content that resists semanticisation = autobiographical).
mapping.mapping_caveat: The persistence of the dissociation across rehearsal could equally be cited by a 'distinct type' proponent. The paper shows WHERE the dissociation lives (within MTL), not whether the autobiographical layer is best modelled as a tag or a type; it is evidence about substrate sharing, not about taxonomy directly.
mapping.source_context: Human fMRI, prospectively-collected naturalistic autobiographical vs semantic audio stimuli, rehearsal manipulation.

confidence_components.notes: High-quality J Neurosci fMRI with ecologically-valid stimuli; mapping fidelity discounted because the same finding is compatible with both poles of Q-060, so it constrains rather than decides.
